name: Hamul
title: Grandson of Judah
summary: Hamul was the son of Perez and grandson of Judah, one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is regarded as the ancestor of the clan of the Hamulites within the tribe of Judah. Although he does not play a prominent role in biblical narratives, he is important as part of Judah's lineage that eventually leads to King David and Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Hamul's Birth and Lineage
keyEvents.description: Hamul was born as the son of Perez, who himself was the son of Judah and Tamar. Through this lineage, Hamul became part of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among Those Who Went to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Hamul is mentioned among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt together with Jacob and his household.

keyEvents.title: The Clan of the Hamulites in the Census
keyEvents.description: During the census in the wilderness, Hamul's descendants were registered as the clan of the Hamulites, one of the clans within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hamul is listed in the genealogy of Judah as a son of Perez, confirming his place in this important lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jesus' ancestral line
keyEvents.description: Through his father Perez and his brother Hezron, Hamul's family is part of the messianic lineage leading to Jesus Christ, even though Hamul himself is not mentioned directly in Jesus' genealogy.
